An '''individual''' served as the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|chief executive officer]] of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] company [[Sord Montok]]. When the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Reerookachuck]] started a riot and escaped after being taken aboard one the company's slave [[Starship/Legends|ships]], the eponymous ''[[Sord Montok (starship)|Sord Montok]]'', the CEO issued a sixty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for the capture of the Wookiee. The CEO likely wanted to make an example of the Reerookachuck to preserve the corporation's image, but stated the Wookiee was to be captured alive to be held accountable for his Wookiees actions.<ref name="BtDF" />
